answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation anchored in the consensus kernel, so duplicate registrations collapse to one stake-weighted key. At the epoch summit, validators sample attestations and cross-check the onyx registry of hardware-rooted commitments, rejecting clones whose provenance proofs fail. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
